narrative.overview:
LUMEN is a dark studio with one light source. The ground is ink, the type is bone, everything secondary is warm stone, and the only colour on the page arrives as spectral dispersion through a real-time 3D crystal. The chrome never competes with the glass: no accent hue, no gradients in the UI, no cards standing in for structure. Hairline rules and very large, wide Archivo carry the hierarchy.

Density is low and the scale is theatrical. Headlines run wide (variable width axis 112 to 125) and tightly tracked, sections are separated by 120 to 200px of ink, and lists are typographic index rows that invert to bone on hover. Motion is one grammar everywhere: expo-out, line-masked reveals, and wipes driven by clip-path.
keyCharacteristics: Ink, bone and stone only; colour comes from refraction, never from a UI token.
Wide Archivo display, set tight; Noto Sans Georgian set looser and calmer.
Bone pill buttons and pill chips; hairline rules instead of containers.
Expo-out everywhere: line reveals, fill wipes, row wipes.
The 3D stage (crystal, wordmark, studio light rig) is the hero and the signature.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: The chrome has no hue. If a surface needs colour, it gets it from the 3D glass, or it stays bone, stone or ink.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: Idea mocks render each template's own palette (`--m-bg`, `--m-fg`, `--m-accent`, `--m-soft`, `--m-art`). Those colours belong to the mock and never leak into LUMEN's chrome.

rules.name: The Georgian Rule
rules.body: `:lang(ka)` is a first-class setting, not a fallback. Body line-height rises to 1.7. Display, headline, index and statement sizes step down (hero clamp(2rem, min(4.6vw, 8svh), 4rem), contact display clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 4.6rem), service names clamp(1.6rem, 3.4vw, 2.8rem), manifesto clamp(1.5rem, 3.3vw, 2.9rem)). Tracking relaxes to -0.01em (the manifesto goes to 0), and line-height opens to 1.1 to 1.3. Never carry Latin's -0.04em tracking onto Mkhedruli.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: LUMEN's own UI is never uppercased or letter-spaced for effect. The only wide tracking is the nav brand (0.14em, 800, `wdth` 125). Uppercase appears only inside mocks, as part of a template's look.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Colour on the page is earned optically: bone light bars, a bone wordmark and white softboxes, split by glass. Never fake dispersion with CSS gradients in the chrome.

dos: Do keep every UI surface to ink, ink-2, bone, stone and the two hairline alphas; let the 3D glass supply all colour.
Do use a bone pill (56px, 999px radius, fill-wipe hover) for the primary action and a `line-2` outline pill for the secondary one.
Do present lists as index rows between hairlines, with the bone clip-path wipe on hover.
Do set every display line with masked, expo-out line reveals and the `--ease` curve.
Do apply the Georgian Rule (looser line-height, -0.01em tracking, smaller display clamps) whenever `:lang(ka)` is active.
Do use tabular numerals for every price, counter and total.
Do build new glass from the Gem recipe and the Studio light rig rather than tuning a new material.
donts: Don't introduce a UI accent hue, gradient fills or coloured glows in the chrome; `danger` and `ok` are for form status only.
Don't use grids of same-size icon cards; the receipt and feature tiles are the only bordered containers.
Don't uppercase or widely track LUMEN's own labels.
Don't apply Latin display tracking (-0.035 to -0.045em) to Georgian.
Don't ship raster images for mocks or icons; mocks are CSS and icons are authored SVG at a 1.8 stroke.
Don't let a mock's borrowed palette or its serif leak into LUMEN's own type or colour.
